name: media-downloader-server
description: Self-hosted yt-dlp media downloader — Express API + SSE + lowdb.

scripts.postinstall: curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o yt-dlp && chmod a+rx yt-dlp && curl -fsSL https://github.com/denoland/deno/releases/latest/download/deno-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip -o deno.zip && unzip -o deno.zip && chmod a+rx deno && rm deno.zip
